description: Skeleton evaluation gold set for RegComply. Labels are at the source-document level (which internal policy document should be retrieved for a given regulatory change pair), not yet at the individual chunk level. Chunk-level gold labels require manual legal/domain review and are tracked as remaining work in report/progress_report.md (May-June 2026 plan). This file exists so `python -m regcomply.eval` has at least one real, runnable case instead of a stub.
